entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-12
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Fix muxer version handling for dotnetup (and installation library) #51691
  • Add dotnetup NativeAOT test coverage #51690
  • Figure out if and how to load hostfxr from NativeAOT code for dotnetup and installation library #51689
  • [wasm][coreclr] handle the generator runs for incremental builds at msbuild level #51688
    11.0.1xx
  • The target "GenerateJSModuleManifestBuildStaticWebAssets" does not exist in the project. #51686
  • Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Web\Sdk\Sdk.props fires buildcheck - condition unintentionally is always false #51685
  • CA1515 is reported when extension members are present despite being suppressed in .editorconfig #51683
  • CA1034 is incorrectly reported for extension members #51681
  • Debian packages malformed. Claim to need 652GB of disk space #51680
  • .NET SDK 10-rc.1 cannot be uninstalled #51676
    Backlog
  • `dotnet restore --locked-mode` does not work as expected (the `contentHash` of `Microsoft.NET.Sdk.WebAssembly.Pack` differs on Windows) #51675
  • `dotnet reference --help` shows incorrect description line #51674

Closed

  • .NET 10 `dotnet run` does not respect DOTNET_ROOT variable #51693
  • Additional clarity for converting file-based app to project-based app via CLI command #50934
    10.0.2xx
  • Targeting .NET 10.0 or higher in Visual Studio 2022 17.14 is not supported #51678
  • Setting `RunAOTCompilation` to `true` causes the `BlazorWebAssembly` build to fail on Linux #51677

Created

  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/9.0.1xx' => 'release/9.0.3xx' #51698
  • [Backport][10.0.2xx] Add suppressor support for `dotnet format` #51697
  • Update branding to 9.0.309 #51696
  • chore: add slnx to gitattributes template #51694
  • Remove more analyzer redirecting VSIX related stuff #51692
  • Enable runtime="net' for all tasks #51684
    Area-Infrastructure

Merged

  • Update Mariner-2-Docker-ARM64 internal build image to Azure-Linux-3-Arm64 #51687
  • Refactor dotnet-watch into a package consumable from Aspire.CLI #51223
  • Improve clarity of 'dotnet project convert' output directory prompt #51443
    Area-run-file
  • Stop bundling obsolete FSharp.NET.SDK #51650
  • Add tests for solution filter with shared projects and platform configuration support #51526
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/9.0.1xx' => 'release/9.0.3xx' #51399
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/8.0.1xx' => 'release/8.0.3xx' #51388
    Area-Containers

    Area-run-file, 10.0.2xx
  • Update to the RTM build of runtime. #51660

  • Merging internal commits for release/8.0.3xx #51659

  • Fix solution parsing in dotnet test for Microsoft.Testing.Platform #51411
